turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_dn_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`, `poscar`
    (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `dn` (the birefringence at
    1064 nm, dimensionless).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict each candidate's birefringence at 1064 nm,
then select the 5 candidates whose birefringence is CLOSEST to 0.1.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, closest first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The birefringence \(\Delta n\) is controlled primarily by crystal anisotropy (cubic/near-cubic cells give \(\Delta n \approx 0\); elongated or layered cells give larger values) together with chemical analogy to the training set. Direct lattice-vector and stoichiometry matches therefore supply reliable estimates:

- c071 (Al2Cu2Ge2Se8) is isostructural with the training chalcopyrites Ga2Cu2Ge2Se8 (\(\Delta n=0.123\)) and Al2Cu2Sn2Se8 (\(\Delta n=0.081\)), yielding \(\Delta n\approx0.102\).
- c004 (Mg8Ga4Se14) has lattice vectors essentially identical to the training phase Li4Mg6Ga4Se14 (\(\Delta n=0.106\)), yielding \(\Delta n\approx0.106\).
- c002 (Mg8Ga4Se14) is a modestly stretched variant of the same family, yielding \(\Delta n\approx0.115\).
- c082 (Al4Hg2Se8) interpolates between Ga4Hg2Se8 (\(\Delta n=0.105\)) and Al4Hg2S8 (\(\Delta n=0.075\)), yielding \(\Delta n\approx0.090\).
- c056 (In2Ag2Ge2Se8) interpolates among In2Cu2Ge2Se8 (\(\Delta n=0.094\)), In2Ag2Sn2Se8 (\(\Delta n=0.079\)) and Ga2Ag2Sn2Se8 (\(\Delta n=0.066\)), yielding \(\Delta n\approx0.087\).

All other candidates are either cubic (\(\Delta n=0\)), far more anisotropic (alkali-pnictides, polytypes, etc.), or map onto training compounds whose \(\Delta n\) lies well outside \(0.08\)–\(0.12\). The five listed materials are therefore those whose predicted \(\Delta n\) lie closest to the target value 0.1 (ranked by increasing \(|\Delta n-0.1|\)).

Final: c071, c004, c002, c082, c056
